# Synthetic PDF fixtures

Generated by `../make-pdf-fixtures.py`; none are real uploaded documents.

- `layout.pdf`: three styled/scanned/mixed-size/rotated test pages; includes a PDF
  JavaScript alert that must NOT execute in the app.
- `protected.pdf`: synthetic encrypted PDF. Test password: `test-password`.
  This is deliberately public test data, not a secret or production credential.
- `long.pdf`: 25 synthetic pages for range and resolution limits.
- `too-tall.pdf`: deliberately oversized page geometry for safe rejection.
